question.text: If a hyperbola has length of its conjugate axis equal to 5 and the distance between its foci is 13 , then the eccentricity of the hyperbola is:

solution.text:
$\therefore$ Conjugate axis $=5$

$\therefore 2 b=5$

Distance betwecn foci $=13$

$2 a e=13$

Then, $b^{2}=a^{2}\left(e^{2}-1\right)$

$\Rightarrow a^{2}=36$

$\therefore a=6$

$a e=\frac{13}{2} \Rightarrow e=\frac{13}{12}$
